sources.SOFR: Federal Reserve Bank of New York

sources.BGCR: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
sources.Commercial_Paper: Federal Reserve Board / FRED; underlying DTCC data

methodology.spread_history: Each spread uses its own maximum pairwise history.
methodology.cp_composite: Mean trailing-252-business-day z-score of available 30D, 60D and 90D A2/P2 minus AA nonfinancial CP spreads; minimum two maturities required.
methodology.monitor_alignment: Monitoring panel permits a maximum five-business-day forward fill. Raw statistical series are not forward filled.
methodology.adf: Augmented Dickey-Fuller test with constant and AIC lag selection.
